goal: Find a path to 10x or greater speedup of simulate!() while preserving mathematical correctness, physical fidelity, and API flexibility. All GPU code MUST use AcceleratedKernels.jl. ALL speedup claims MUST be backed by Metal GPU benchmarks.
v1_lesson: v1 spent 5 iterations on static analysis and CPU benchmarks. The resulting optimizations produced ZERO speedup on Metal GPU. v2 requires GPU benchmarks for every claim.

context.scope: simulate!() ONLY — forward projection + detector physics pipeline. Reconstruction (reconstruct!) is OUT OF SCOPE.
context.architecture: AcceleratedKernels.jl (AK.jl) for GPU-agnostic execution (Metal/CUDA/ROCm/CPU). Zero-allocation workspace pattern. Polychromatic via sequential energy bin loop.
context.hard_constraint: AcceleratedKernels.jl is NON-NEGOTIABLE. All GPU compute must go through AK.jl. No backend-specific kernels.
context.math_constraint: Same mathematical results (within floating-point tolerance). Same API. Same physics fidelity.
context.gpu_constraint: ALL performance measurements on Metal GPU with Metal.@sync + @elapsed. CPU-only benchmarks are NOT acceptable evidence.

gpu_baseline.signal_chain_ms_note: CORRECTED: SPEED-000 reported 487ms due to Metal.synchronize() measurement artifacts. Real value is 6ms.
gpu_baseline.fused_vs_unfused: Fused is 3.65x SLOWER on Metal GPU (register spill at 234 bins)

topics.title: GPU Profiling Baseline — Metal @elapsed on every component of simulate!()
topics.notes: Baseline established. Fused kernel 3.65x SLOWER on GPU. Forward proj 96.4% of time. 234 energy bins. Signal chain 0.1% (NOT 8.2% — SPEED-000 measurement was wrong). Physics pipeline 0.4%. SPEED-003 corrected signal chain from 487ms to 6ms.

topics.title: Tiled Energy Fusion — K=16 bins per DDA pass, 3.79× GPU-validated
topics.notes: GPU VALIDATED: K=16 → 95.3ms/tile × 15 tiles = 1430ms (3.66× vs unfused 5232ms). Per-bin marginal cost = 5.96ms. Build story SPEED-BUILD-V2-002 created. From default fused baseline (19.2s), this is 12× speedup. Benchmarks: bench_speed_001.jl, bench_speed_003.jl

topics.title: Ray Tracing Algorithm — GPU-validated alternatives to Siddon
topics.notes: 10× from current baseline is already achieved with tiled fusion (12×). Alternative projector would only be needed for 10× from unfused baseline (need 540ms total, below 1404ms per-bin floor). HIGH EFFORT, LOW MARGINAL IMPACT given 12× already achieved.

topics.title: GPU Kernel Optimization — per-bin cost decomposition
topics.notes: DONE — Per-bin 6ms floor is INSTRUCTION-BOUND (not memory or data dependent). All-zero μ_table = same timing. All-tissue phantom = same timing. Air skipping INVALIDATED. μ_table layout INVALIDATED. The 6ms × 234 = 1404ms is a hard floor for tiled Siddon. No further optimization possible within current architecture.

topics.title: Signal Chain — actually only 6ms (NOT 487ms)
topics.notes: DONE — Signal chain is 6ms total, not 487ms. SPEED-000's measurement was wrong (Metal.synchronize() barrier overhead). Each elementwise kernel: 1-2ms. Fusion saves 5ms. NOT worth a build story. Benchmark: bench_speed_003.jl

topics.title: SYNTHESIS: 12× speedup achieved — finalize build stories
topics.notes: 12× achieved from current default (19.2s → 1.6s) with just V2-001 (disable fused) + V2-002 (tiled K=16). Signal chain and per-bin optimizations are negligible. Only 2 build stories needed. Next: critique + refinement of build stories, then SPEED_COMPLETE.
